reason: H0 exclusively configures WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and drives wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens or wuffs_aux::DecodeJson, so it does not reach the XZ checksum path in wuffs_xz__decoder__do_transform_io or decoder.do_transform_io. That is a pre-existing scope gap, not one introduced or materially aggravated by this commit: S0 and S1 perform the same four SHA-256 bit-vector element comparisons at indices 3, 2, 1, and 0; only the accessor name changes from wuffs_base__bitvec256__get/get to wuffs_base__bitvec256__get_u64/get_u64, while its body remains return b->elements_u64[i & 3]. No entry point, protocol, state, configuration, input semantics, or attack surface changed.
evidence: H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and calls wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens in fuzz_complex and fuzz_simple.
H0's C++ path calls wuffs_aux::DecodeJson in fuzz_cpp; no H0 function invokes wuffs_xz__decoder__do_transform_io or decoder.do_transform_io.
wuffs_base__bitvec256__get was renamed to wuffs_base__bitvec256__get_u64, but the implementation remains return b->elements_u64[i & 3].
The four calls in wuffs_xz__decoder__do_transform_io and decoder.do_transform_io only change get to get_u64 for the same indices and comparisons against checksum64_want.
recommended_action: No maintenance is needed for H0 for this commit. Any desired XZ decoder fuzzing should be handled as separate coverage work rather than attributed to this accessor-only rename.
